Measure, price and send from the job site

The same three steps for a bedroom, a backyard or a villa ceiling.

  1. 01

    Measure

    Type the room, enter one quick total, count the doors, or trace the lot on the satellite map. A 12 × 12 room is two taps.

  2. 02

    Price

    Your measurement × your rate, from a rate card already filled in for your trade and region. Every number shows its formula. Edit any row.

  3. 03

    Get paid

    Send a proposal with your name and logo by WhatsApp, text or email. Your client picks an option and accepts on their phone. Ask for a deposit, issue the invoice, and record each payment as it arrives.

What you get

Four things Metrado does, and nothing it does not.

1

Numbers you can defend

Your measurement × your rate, calculated the same way every time. Each line shows its formula and where the measurement came from, and you can edit any row.

The formula is always on screen.

2

Private by design

There is no account to create. Your jobs, clients and photos stay on your phone. No ads, no tracking, no selling of data.

Delete everything from Settings.

3

Your language, your direction

English, Spanish and Arabic, with full right-to-left layouts. Your documents follow the language you choose.

Arabic is built in, not bolted on.

4

Proposals clients can answer

Send a link by WhatsApp, text or email. Your client opens it on their phone, picks an option and taps Accept, which opens a message back to you. You then mark the job as accepted.

Nothing for your client to install.

Built for trades that price by size

Pick your trade and your rate card is ready, with regional defaults you can edit.

  • Painters

    Interior and exterior. Per room, per wall area or per hour, with coats, coverage and prep.

  • Landscapers

    Sod, turf, pavers, beds and edging. Trace the lot on the satellite map and price by area.

  • Finishing trades

    Gypsum and drywall, flooring and tile. Priced per area with waste allowance, ceilings on their own.

Metrado is the measure-to-money tool. It does not do scheduling, dispatch or ground-up construction estimating. If you already use a field-service suite, keep it and send the proposal from here.

Your business stays on your phone

No account. No ads. No tracking.

  • No account

    Open the app and start measuring. There is no sign-up, no password and no email to confirm.

  • Your data is on your phone

    Jobs, clients, rates, photos and signatures live on your device. Share only what you choose to send.

  • Delete it whenever you like

    Settings › Data › Delete all data removes everything from the app, including referral data.

  • A person answers

    Write to support and a person replies, in English, Spanish or Arabic.

Plans

Metrado Pro is a subscription through the App Store. Prices below are for the United States; they vary by region.

  • Annual

    $119.99 per year

    14-day trial for eligible new subscribers

  • Founder annual

    $69.99 per year

    Limited founder offer, shown in the app while it lasts

  • Monthly

    $12.99 per month

  • Weekly

    $3.99 per week

  • The price, billing period and any trial are always shown in the app and on the App Store before you pay, in your own currency.
  • The annual plan's trial comes with a reminder before it bills.
  • Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel in your Apple ID settings. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.
  • Your documents stay on your phone, and you can export them whether or not you subscribe.

Questions contractors ask

Do I need an account?

No. There is no sign-up. Your data lives on your phone.

How is the price worked out?

It is your measurement × your rate, with the formula on screen. Edit any number and the total follows.

How does my client accept?

You send a link. They open it, choose an option and tap Accept, which opens a message to you in WhatsApp, text or email. You then tap Mark as accepted in the app. You can also have your client sign on your phone, in person.

Is that a legally binding signature?

Whether an acceptance or signature is binding depends on your contract and the law where you work. Metrado records who accepted, what and when. It gives no legal advice, so check with your own advisor if the job needs more.

What does the link contain?

The proposal itself is inside the link, so there is no Metrado server holding it. Anyone you send the link to can read it. A proposal link is not proof of anything on its own, which is why every document has a check code and a page explaining how to confirm it by phone.

Does it work offline?

Measuring, pricing and making the document work offline. The satellite map and sending need a connection.

Does it file taxes or submit e-invoices?

No. Metrado makes quotes, invoices and receipts. It does not file taxes or submit documents to a tax authority.

Which phones does it run on?

iPhone, in English, Spanish and Arabic.

My spreadsheet works fine.

Keep it. The first quote in Metrado takes a few minutes and goes out as a professional PDF with your logo.
